g.text: Building at the intersection of edge computing

破灭的宿命亦是重生的喜悦
Destruction is the joy of rebirth. — AincFh
Zero-latency serverless · 零延迟无服务器

Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2 + KV. Zero-overhead delivery.
用边缘网络做零开销全球分发，用克制的架构换长期可维护。
